verdicts.project_owned: PARTIAL: formula-relative time; spatial canvas coordinates remain
verdicts.UJI: SPATIAL_DERIVED: transformed coordinates and baseline context; no time
verdicts.ISGL: SCHEMA_ONLY: source canvas coordinates retained; no point time
verdicts.UCI: PRENORMALIZED_UNVERIFIABLE: publisher-transformed only, no raw pair
verdicts.BDSHWA: DEVICE_TO_CANVAS_ONLY: affine canvas mapping, not glyph normalization
verdicts.CROHME: EVALUATION_ONLY: raw InkML at rest; median-height normalization in evaluator
verdicts.HF_reaudit: UNVERIFIED: parquet reader/license provenance absent from approved pipeline
